name: Cilnidipine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 5 to 10 mg once daily after breakfast; up to 20 mg once daily; severe hypertension 10 to 20 mg once daily

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Azole antifungals (itraconazole, miconazole), cimetidine, grapefruit juice

key_interactions.effect: Calcium-channel blockers can raise digoxin levels.

pk.half_life: About 7 hours single dose (5.2 hours on day 1 to 8.1 hours on day 7 with repeat dosing)
pk.half_life_eskd: Unchanged at serum creatinine 1.5 to 3.1 mg/dL
pk.excretion_renal_pct: No unchanged drug in urine; metabolites 5.2%

sources.citation: Sawai Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (2023). Cilnidipine tablets 5 mg, 10 mg and 20 mg "SAWAI" [Japanese package insert, 1st edition, revised June 2023]. Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), Japan.

revision_log.change: PK peak corrected to 2.5–2.8 h; single-dose half-life about 7 h added.
